expected: surface shown, then ~50% transparent with the cartoon visible underneath

request: try the surface as a mesh instead of solid
expected: surface style mesh; nothing else
check: any(m.__class__.__name__=='MolecularSurface' and m.display and m.display_style=='mesh' for m in models)

request: only show the surface within 8 angstroms of the fpp ligand, its too much otherwise
expected: surface zone near :FPP distance 8 (or surface patches of that zone only)
check: any(m.__class__.__name__=='MolecularSurface' and m.display and m.triangle_mask is not None and 0 < int(m.triangle_mask.sum()) < len(m.triangle_mask) for m in models)

request: smooth it out a bit with a gaussian filter, sdev 2
expected: volume gaussian #1 sDev 2 (new filtered map)

request: fetch me the alphafold model for O51E2_HUMAN
expected: UniProt entry name resolved to Q8TCB6; AlphaFold model opened
check: any(m.__class__.__name__=='AtomicStructure' and ('Q9H255' in m.name.upper() or 'O51E2' in m.name.upper()) for m in models)

request: save my progress so I dont lose this
expected: saves a .cxs session (asks for confirmation)

request: load this consurf alignment and color the structure by conservation: https://www.rbvi.ucsf.edu/chimerax/data/conservation-coloring/121p-consurf.aln
followups: only show me the residues that are highly conserved, over 1.8

request: does this protein have any uniprot annotations, like domains or known variants
expected: protein_features (or annotate) for P69905; answer lists what UniProt has

request: label everything thats currently shown
followups: make the labels bigger and red
get rid of that BTN 300 label, its not useful
expected: residue labels on shown residues, red and bigger, BTN label removed

request: whats the help command do, like help style

request: reload chimerax, I want a clean slate
expected: cannot restart the app; offers close session (asks for confirmation) or asks

request: zoom out so I can see the whole molecule
expected: view (fit all)
check: any(re.match(r'view(\s+(all|#1|/A|protein|cartoon))?\s*$', c, re.I) for c in ran) or any(re.search('^zoom\\s+0?\\.\\d', c, re.I) for c in ran)

request: select the ligand and zoom in on it
expected: select :STI (ligand); view sel
check: (lambda s: len(s)>0 and set(s.residues.names)=={'STI'})(atoms.filter(atoms.selecteds)) and any(re.search('^view\\b', c, re.I) for c in ran)

request: open 1stp
followups: hide the waters, theyre in the way
select the ligand and color it green with proper heteroatom colors
now find the h-bonds between it and the protein and label the distances
expected: 1stp open, waters hidden, biotin green carbons with heteroatom colors, its H-bonds shown with distances
check: not atoms.filter(atoms.structure_categories=='solvent').displays.any() and (lambda s: len(s)>0 and all((lambda c: c[1]>=100 and c[0]<=120 and c[2]<=120)(tuple(int(x) for x in a.color)) for a in s))([a for a in atoms if (a.residue.name=='BTN' and a.element.name=='C')]) and not any((lambda c: c[1]>=100 and c[0]<=120 and c[2]<=120)(tuple(int(x) for x in a.color)) for a in atoms if a.residue.name=='BTN' and a.element.name in ('N','O')) and (lambda pbs: len(pbs)>=1 and all('BTN' in (b.atoms[0].residue.name, b.atoms[1].residue.name) for b in pbs))([b for m in models if m.__class__.__name__=='PseudobondGroup' and 'hydrogen' in m.name.lower() and m.display for b in m.pseudobonds if b.display]) and (any(m.__class__.__name__=='ObjectLabels' and len(m.labels())>0 and m.parent.__class__.__name__=='PseudobondGroup' for m in models) or any(re.search('show\\s*dist', c, re.I) for c in ran))

request: open 6fqf, thats hemoglobin
followups: just show chain A, hide the rest
load 3rgk too and overlay it onto that chain
save an image of the superimposed structures
expected: 6fqf only chain A shown, 3rgk superposed on it, image save confirmed

followups: hide the water and glycerol, dont need those
color the protein surface by electrostatic potential
add a color key and label it electrostatic potential

request: open the crystal structure of GroEL, 1grl
followups: add its cryo-em map too, from emdb, its 1080
bump the contour up a bit and clean up the noisy bits
now fit the structure into that map
